$schemaNotes: Content+asset source of truth for the Aigenetic site template. Extracted from index.html, healthcare.html and config.js on 2026-08-24, with zero content loss. All asset paths are relative to this newSite/ folder. See newSite/CLAUDE.md for how to use this file to build a new page.

meta.siteNameCasingRule: Always render the brand name exactly as 'Aigenetic' (capital A only) — never 'AiGenetic', 'aigenetic', 'AIGenetic', etc.

default.description: Tailwind CDN + hand-rolled CSS variables. Light, editorial, generous whitespace. Used by the main React/JSX landing page.
default.engine: Tailwind CSS (CDN, darkMode:'class') + custom <style> block, no build step
default.$designNote: Resynced 2026-08-24 to healthcare.html's 2026-08-23 redesign, in this page's own React/Tailwind idiom — zero copy changes, only presentation. Added: derived surface/motion tokens (--card, --line-soft, --mint-deep, --r-sm/md/lg, --sh-1/2/3, --ease) layered on top of cssVariables below without altering a single brand hex; a fixed ambient radial wash on body::before plus a masked grid on the hero (.hero-grid-wash); a sticky header that gains a background/shadow only after scroll (#header.scrolled, via a scroll-position React state) and, below 768px, replaces the nav links/CTAs with a hamburger (.nav-toggle) opening a conditionally-rendered panel (#mobile-nav-panel) — index.html previously had no mobile nav at all, the links just vanished under `hidden md:flex` with nothing to replace them, which is the bug nav.$mobilePattern's healthcare hamburger already fixed there; the hero key-feature strip rendered as four hover-lift cards (.stat-card) instead of plain text columns; a mono index badge (.card-idx) on each Use Cases card; a new dark rounded closing CTA panel (.closing-panel) after the pricing section, reusing hero's own CTA labels rather than adding new marketing copy; and section entrances via a small <Reveal> React component (IntersectionObserver-driven, mirrors .reveal/.stagger) with a full prefers-reduced-motion opt-out. Behavior (calendar modal, audio player, live-call teaser) is unchanged; the calendar-modal-main dialog gained backdrop blur, a modal-in animation, Escape-to-close, body-scroll lock and ARIA (role=dialog/aria-modal/aria-labelledby), matching healthcare.html's #calendar-modal.

derivedTokens.notes: Same derived-token pattern as theme.clinicalTeal — no new brand hues, just surface/shadow/radius/easing values layered on the palette above. Keep both theme blocks' derived tokens identical if either changes (root CLAUDE.md main/child sync rule).

clinicalTeal.description: Vanilla CSS custom-properties palette. Calmer, clinical, mono accents for data/log feel. Used by vertical/child landing pages (healthcare and — by pattern — future verticals like realestate).
clinicalTeal.engine: Plain CSS custom properties in a <style> block, no Tailwind, no build step
clinicalTeal.notes: Same ink/teal/mint hues as theme.default's --primary/--accent/--mint, just named differently and with a mono accent font added. Treat the two themes as the same brand palette in two different implementations (Tailwind-driven vs vanilla-CSS-driven) — keep hex values identical if either is edited, per the root CLAUDE.md main/child sync rule.

usedIn: index.html footer (inverted: filter brightness(0) invert(1) on dark background)

common.description: Full 6-clip demo set, used by index.html's 'Hear Our AI Agents in Action' showcase grid. Shared across every page that renders the showcase.

healthcare.description: healthcare.html only plays its own single relevant sample (the 'Hear the assistant' voice-sample player), so that one clip is duplicated locally under the page's own folder.

assets.namingConvention: assets/common/<type>/<usage-name>.<ext> for anything reused identically across every page; assets/pages/<pageKey>/<type>/<usage-name>.<ext> for anything unique to, or deliberately duplicated for, one page. See newSite/CLAUDE.md § Asset rules.

limits.eyebrow: Hard limits, set by us, not by prompt
limits.heading: What it will never do
limits.subheading: Your name is on the board outside. These three refusals are built into the product and cannot be turned on, by you or by us.

items.title: No diagnosis, no advice
items.desc: Symptoms are logged for you and the caller is offered the earliest slot. Nothing more.

items.title: No medicine names, no dosages
items.desc: Not even repeats of what you prescribed last visit. Refills go to you.

items.title: No results read over the phone
items.desc: "Ready for collection" is the whole answer. Values stay in the file.

escalation.heading: And one thing it always does
escalation.desc: If a caller describes chest pain, breathlessness, heavy bleeding, a seizure, or an unresponsive patient, the assistant stops booking mid-sentence, reads out the nearest emergency number, and rings your on-duty mobile until someone picks up.
